user_correction: A complete personally operable domestic securities/futures strategy needs concrete instruments, weights, operating method, and risk actions; a boundary memo alone is insufficient.
original_misses: No frozen candidate strategy connected named instruments, weights, and operating rules.
Product diligence, historical diagnostics, and personal operation controls were not linked into a reader-facing decision card.
The difference between a long-run five-percent research hurdle and a stable annual return was insufficiently structural.

repair_workstreams.purpose: Freeze and evaluate an economically motivated low-frequency ETF candidate using retained research inputs without converting a price proxy into total-return or execution evidence.
Refresh product-level diligence for every potential candidate ETF and identify a lean core set without a buy recommendation.
Specify personal-operation, transaction, no-action, and risk controls for a candidate strategy.
Integrate only mutually consistent C30-C32 evidence into a candidate strategy or formally downgrade it.
Verify rule implementation, arithmetic, source references, and non-guarantee language before any paper-operable status is considered.

guardrails.five_percent: Long-run research hurdle only; never a guarantee, annual floor, prediction, or personal outcome.
guardrails.universe: Open research universe, but each rule version freezes its actual instruments before computation.
guardrails.futures: May enter only through a separately evidenced eligibility, margin, position-limit, roll, and data gate; never to fill a return shortfall.
